title: Region Rebalance for Long-Tailed Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Pool pixel features per class per image into region features and train an auxiliary rebalanced region classifier; region-level counts are far less imbalanced than pixel counts.
adaptation: Region imbalance in our data is mild (splice 53/478 cells) while pixel imbalance is extreme, matching the premise. Pool full-res U-Net++ decoder features per class per cell; auxiliary balanced linear classifier; drop at test. About 50 lines.
min_experiment: Arm: RR auxiliary branch weight 0.5, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100 (or best loss/sampling arm); metric mIoU_rob and splice/edge_dark IoU; kill if mIoU_rob < +0.01.
evidence: R: consistent gains on ADE20K and COCO-Stuff; BEiT +0.7 mIoU on ADE20K val.
